note: The pipeline is code that decides what reaches production, so a change to it is reviewed as such. The pipeline-guard check (Lab 15.1 builds it) runs from the platform team's repository (governance/required-workflows.json) and reads this file from the base branch, never from the pull request. Team membership comes from the platform's API at check time.

rules.PG001: a pull request that changes a pipeline path changes nothing else
rules.PG002: two approvals by people after the last push, at least one from the owner team; never the author, the agent's requester or an agent
rules.PG003: a gate change (GD001-GD010: any weakening the diff names, any change to a required job's commands, any change to gate configuration) also needs an approval from the weakening team and a line 'Gate change: RLY-n: <reason>' in the description
rules.PG004: the guard cannot read team membership or the diff: it fails (exit 2), it never passes

limits: Tests are not a gate path: a pull request that deletes or skips a test is reviewed by the tests' code owners, not by this guard.
